h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Patna

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Patna

items.pText: Patna has a large number of private schools, and several of them run more than one branch across the city and in nearby towns. When a school group sets up new playgrounds, it often wants every campus to look and work the same way, so that parents recognise the school and staff follow one maintenance routine. Planning several sites at once is something we can help with.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km from Patna, and sends it to Bihar by road. Our installation team or a Bihar dealer sets it up. We also supply housing societies, apartment builders and parks along the Ganga. Send us the size of each campus play area, the age groups and photos. We will prepare a layout drawing for each site with the safe play area marked.

items.q: Can you supply the same playground to several of our Patna branches?
items.a: Yes. We can plan a standard set of equipment for all branches and adjust it for each site, with a separate layout drawing for every campus.

items.q: Who do we contact for after-sales support?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

items.q: Do you deliver to Patna and nearby towns such as Danapur and Hajipur?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer working in Bihar. The process is the same as for a Patna site.
